data.long_meaning: Bratindra is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Brahma' meaning God or Supreme Being and 'Indra' meaning Lord of the Universe. Naming a child Bratindra is believed to bestow upon them divine blessings and protection.
